step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram illustrates Samsung Health's backend architecture. Traffic enters through API Gateway, routes via VPC Link to a Network Load Balancer (NLB), which forwards requests to multiple Amazon EKS clusters via target groups and node ports. Monitoring, logging, and tracing services (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, CloudWatch, X-Ray) are shown standalone at the bottom without explicit diagram lines.
